name: Enchanted Evening
base_description: Drakness in her Midnight Violet evening gown (see clothing/gown.json), hair and makeup already set
notes: The TWO-STAGE path: assumes you've already picked/rendered her Clothing: Gown image (data/art/_sets/drakn-sisters/drakness/clothing/gown.json) and feed THAT in, rather than an A-pose. Preserves outfit/hair entirely (scene-human.txt), only adds a soft ambient glow + an enchanting evening backdrop + a calmer pose. Complements the Elegant Casting scene, which is the single-stage A-pose-to-full-scene path for a combat/casting look.
